metadata.name: velvet_launch
metadata.description: Anti-snipe fair launchpad: PDA-owned mints, atomic creator buy, uniform-price batch auction opening, decaying snipe fee

instructions.name: apply_config
docs: Apply the queued change once its timelock has passed. Anyone can call it.

instructions.name: apply_config_ext
docs: Anyone can apply the queued extra settings once the timelock has passed.

accounts.name: commitment
docs: the seeds; buys count any unclaimed line tokens in it toward the 3% cap.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claim your share of the line's tokens (plus overfill refund), or your full
refund if the launch was cancelled. Closes the commitment.

accounts.name: commitment
docs: to this launch and user, and the handler checks owner, discriminator and fields.

instructions.name: claim_vested
docs: Creator takes whatever part of their opening buy has vested.

instructions.name: collect_pool_fees
docs: Permissionless. Collect the locked LP's trading fees through the fee key:
SOL is split between treasury, creator and the holder pool. A quarter of the
treasury share, paired with the coin side, goes back into the pool as permanent
liquidity; any coin left over is burned.

accounts.name: grad_lp
docs: liquidity's LP tokens, which are burned straight away

instructions.name: collect_velvet_fees
docs: Permissionless: collect a Velvet Pools coin's fees (0.15% of every swap, in SOL) and split
them in three equal parts: the coin's holders (hold-streak pool), its creator, and Velvet.

instructions.name: commit
docs: Commit SOL to the opening line.

accounts.name: commitment
docs: topped up); the seeds pin it to this launch and user, the handler checks the rest.

instructions.name: create_launch
docs: Create the coin: PDA mint, metadata, fixed supply, minting off, creator buy
into vesting escrow, opening line starts. All in one instruction.

instructions.name: create_launch_signed
docs: Free launch: the creator signed an approval off-chain (an Ed25519
instruction right before this one); whoever sends this transaction pays the
account rent, normally the coin's first buyer joining the line in the same
transaction. The coin is identical to a normal launch without an opening buy.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent for the new coin's accounts (normally its first buyer).

instructions.name: disable_distributor
docs: Emergency brake: instantly switch hold-streak payouts off (no timelock, since
it can only stop money moving). Turning them back on goes through the timelock.

instructions.name: distribute_rewards
docs: Hold-streak payout. The distributor computes each holder's share off-chain
and pushes SOL from this launch's reward pool. Every recipient must be passed
as (token account, wallet) and must currently hold the coin.
The program limits what the distributor key can do even if it is stolen:
epochs are at least `min_reward_epoch_secs` apart, an epoch can pay out at most
the pool as it stood when the epoch started, and nobody can receive more than
MAX_STREAK_MULT times their share of circulating supply.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Permissionless, step 2: create the Raydium CPMM pool (only while new coins still bond
into Raydium; see `graduate_velvet`).

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: Fresh keypair for the Raydium pool account (signs; Raydium creates it).

instructions.name: graduate_velvet
docs: Permissionless, step 2 when new coins bond into Velvet Pools: create the coin's pool with
the curve's SOL and the LP reserve. Velvet Pools has no withdraw at all, so the liquidity
is locked by design (no locker step).

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority can initialise the config, so nobody
can grab a freshly deployed program first.

instructions.name: init_config_ext
docs: Create the extra settings account (once). Its values then change only through the timelock.

instructions.name: lock_liquidity
docs: Permissionless, step 3 (second transaction): lock all LP with Raydium's
locker. The liquidity can never be withdrawn; the fee-key NFT goes to the
graduation authority so only this program can collect the pool fees.

accounts.name: fee_nft_mint
docs: New keypair for the fee-key NFT mint (signs the transaction).

instructions.name: prepare_graduation
docs: Permissionless, step 1 of graduation (same transaction as `graduate`):
pay the graduation fee and move the curve's SOL to the graduation authority.
Kept separate because lamports moved by hand can't be followed by a CPI in
the same instruction.

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: Queue a config change. It can only be applied after the current timelock,
so everyone sees fee or treasury changes coming. The Raydium program, AMM
config and locker are fixed for the life of the program.

instructions.name: refund_creator
docs: Cancelled launch: the creator's opening buy is undone (minus its fee).

accounts.name: commitment
docs: the seeds; buys count any unclaimed line tokens in it toward the 3% cap.

instructions.name: set_storage
docs: Hand the config to a new authority (e.g. a Squads multisig). Two steps so a
typo can't lose control.
Set the storage wallet and per-coin fee (default key turns it off). The fee is capped at
MAX_STORAGE_FEE, so this takes effect immediately.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Permissionless. After the window: cancel if below the minimum, otherwise run
the whole line as one buy at one price and open trading.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MetadataTooLong
errors.msg: Name, symbol or URI too long

errors.name: CreatorBuyTooLarge
errors.msg: Creator buy exceeds the allowed maximum

errors.name: NotSettled
errors.msg: Auction not settled yet; curve trading is locked

errors.name: NotCreator
errors.msg: Only the creator can do this

errors.name: LaunchCancelled
errors.msg: Launch was cancelled: the line closed below its minimum

errors.name: MinRaiseTooHigh
errors.msg: Minimum raise is above the house limit

errors.name: VestTooLong
errors.msg: Vesting period is above the house limit

errors.name: NotDistributor
errors.msg: Only the reward distributor can do this

errors.name: BadRewardAccount
errors.msg: Reward recipient is not a holder of this coin

errors.name: GraduationUnderfunded
errors.msg: Not enough SOL in the curve to graduate

errors.name: TimelockNotReady
errors.msg: The timelock on this config change hasn't passed yet

errors.name: ImmutableField
errors.msg: Raydium program, AMM config and locker can't be changed

errors.name: NotPendingAuthority
errors.msg: Only the proposed new authority can accept

errors.name: EpochTooSoon
errors.msg: Too soon for the next reward epoch

errors.name: EpochWindowClosed
errors.msg: This reward epoch's payout window has closed

errors.name: RewardAboveShare
errors.msg: Payout is above the recipient's share of the epoch

errors.name: WalletCapExceeded
errors.msg: This buy would take your wallet above 3% of the supply while the coin is bonding

errors.name: BadApproval
errors.msg: Launch approval is missing, malformed or doesn't match this launch

errors.name: CurveFillTooEarly
errors.msg: The curve can't be completed while the cover charge is still on: buy a little less, or wait a minute

fields.name: distributor
docs: Key allowed to push hold-streak payouts from a launch's reward pool.

fields.name: cpmm_program
docs: Raydium CPMM program and AMM config used for graduation.

fields.name: lock_program
docs: Raydium liquidity locker ("Burn & Earn").

fields.name: base_fee_bps
docs: Normal fee on every curve trade, e.g. 100 = 1%.

fields.name: holder_fee_bps
docs: Part of the base fee that goes to the holder reward pool, e.g. 25 = 0.25% of volume.

fields.name: max_snipe_fee_bps
docs: Fee when the doors open, e.g. 5000 = 50%.

fields.name: cover_to_holders_bps
docs: Share of the cover charge premium (fee above base) sent to holders, in bps of the premium.

fields.name: pool_fee_creator_bps
docs: Split of Raydium creator fees after graduation, bps of the SOL collected.

fields.name: virtual_sol
docs: Curve shape for new launches (mainnet uses the INITIAL_* / CURVE_REAL_TOKENS defaults).

fields.name: timelock_secs
docs: Every config change waits this long between proposal and apply.

fields.name: pending
docs: Queued change (pending_eta == 0 means none).

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Two-step authority hand-over (e.g. to a multisig).

fields.name: storage_wallet
docs: Permanent storage: every new coin pays `storage_fee` lamports to `storage_wallet`, which
buys the Arweave credits that store its logo and metadata. Default key = off.
(Carved out of the old 64 reserved bytes, so existing configs read as "off".)

fields.name: min_reward_epoch_secs
docs: Shortest gap between two hold-streak epochs.

types.name: ExtParams
docs: Extra settings that didn't fit the original Config, behind the same timelock.

fields.name: big_line_sol
docs: A line that puts more than this into the curve unlocks gradually.

fields.name: big_line_unlock_bps
docs: Share of each big-line spot claimable when the doors open (bps).

fields.name: big_line_vest_secs
docs: The rest unlocks linearly over this long.

fields.name: velvet_pools
docs: New coins bond into Velvet Pools instead of Raydium.

fields.name: pass_min_committers
docs: Velvet Pass: a line only counts in a launch with at least this many wallets in its line
(0 = PASS_DEFAULT_MIN_COMMITTERS).

fields.name: pass_min_line_total
docs: ...and at least this much SOL in its line in total (0 = PASS_DEFAULT_MIN_LINE_TOTAL).

fields.name: _spare
docs: Room for later settings without moving the layout.

fields.name: lp_reserve
docs: Tokens reserved for the Raydium pool (total supply minus curve tokens).

fields.name: unclaimed_batch
docs: Batch tokens not yet claimed (still in the vault, not part of the LP reserve).

fields.name: escrow_sol
docs: Lamports held for line refunds and overfill refunds.

fields.name: cancelled
docs: Line closed below its minimum: everyone is refunded, the coin never trades.

fields.name: grad_pool_sol
docs: SOL already moved to the graduation authority, waiting for the pool.

fields.name: fee_nft_mint
docs: Fee-key NFT from the locker; held by the graduation authority.

fields.name: line_unlock_bps
docs: Line unlock schedule, fixed at settle (0 secs = everything claimable at once). Big lines
(see ConfigExt) unlock `line_unlock_bps` at open and the rest linearly over
`line_vest_secs` from `vest_start`. Carved out of the old 64 reserved bytes, so launches
settled before read as "no vesting".

fields.name: pool_kind
docs: Where the coin bonded: 0 = Raydium CPMM, 1 = Velvet Pools.

types.name: Pass
docs: Velvet Pass: a wallet's record across every Velvet coin, kept by the program.
Tiers: 0 Guest, 1 Regular (3+ lines), 2 VIP (10+ lines and 5+ SOL put in, no recent flip).
A line counts once, when its tokens are first claimed, if the wallet put in at least
PASS_MIN_LINE_SOL and the launch went ahead. A "flip" is a sell while the cover charge is still
on: it drops the wallet one tier until it has PASS_HEAL_LINES more clean lines.
